title: Docket
_lyrics_source: fragments + thematic description (full lyrics blocked by copyright sites)
lyrics: I said don't shake my hand it's wet. Self-loathing romp on tour. Splitting off from parts of yourself to adapt to new environments. Wanting to cope with distance and change but also being reckless. Brazen, blistering, blistery banger about love on the road. Wedding ring kiss bite cut burn fight. Court, docket, charges, list of guilty pleasures. Hooking up. Bruise. Wound. Wreck.
